hook.en: Tighten a bolt with a spanner: you push sideways, yet the bolt moves along its own axis, at right angles to both the spanner and your push. The cross product gives exactly such a perpendicular vector.
hook.kn: ಸ್ಪ್ಯಾನರ್‌ನಿಂದ ಬೋಲ್ಟ್ ಬಿಗಿಮಾಡಿ: ನೀವು ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳುತ್ತೀರಿ, ಬೋಲ್ಟ್ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬವಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಡ್ಡ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ ಅಂತಹ ಲಂಬ ಸದಿಶವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Find a⃗ × b⃗ as a determinant
Use the properties of the cross product
Find areas of parallelograms and triangles

narration.en: Tighten a bolt with a spanner: you push sideways, yet the bolt moves along its own axis, at right angles to both the spanner and your push. The cross product gives exactly such a perpendicular vector.
narration.kn: ಸ್ಪ್ಯಾನರ್‌ನಿಂದ ಬೋಲ್ಟ್ ಬಿಗಿಮಾಡಿ: ನೀವು ಪಕ್ಕಕ್ಕೆ ತಳ್ಳುತ್ತೀರಿ, ಬೋಲ್ಟ್ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬವಾಗಿ ತನ್ನ ಅಕ್ಷದ ಉದ್ದಕ್ಕೆ ಚಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅಡ್ಡ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ ಅಂತಹ ಲಂಬ ಸದಿಶವನ್ನು ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: $\vec a\times\vec b = |\vec a||\vec b|\sin\theta\,\hat n$, where $\hat n$ is the unit vector perpendicular to both, given by the right-hand rule. It is not commutative: $\vec b\times\vec a = -\,\vec a\times\vec b$. Also $\vec a\times\vec a = \vec 0$, and non-zero vectors are parallel exactly when $\vec a\times\vec b = \vec 0$.
body.kn: a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂, n̂ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬವಾದ ಏಕಮಾನ ಸದಿಶ (ಬಲಗೈ ನಿಯಮ). b × a = −(a × b). a × b = 0 ಆದರೆ ಸದಿಶಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರ.

points.en: î × ĵ = k̂, ĵ × k̂ = î, k̂ × î = ĵ

narration.en: The cross product is a vector of length a b sine theta, perpendicular to both a and b, in the direction given by the right-hand rule. Swapping the order reverses it. Parallel vectors have a zero cross product.
narration.kn: a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂, n̂ ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬವಾದ ಏಕಮಾನ ಸದಿಶ (ಬಲಗೈ ನಿಯಮ). b × a = −(a × b). a × b = 0 ಆದರೆ ಸದಿಶಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರ.

narration.en: The teacher shows the direction and size of a × b, computes it as a determinant and uses it for the area of a triangle.

say.en: a cross b is a vector perpendicular to both a and b. Its direction is given by the right-hand rule.
Its length is a b sine theta, which is the area of the parallelogram on a and b.
Order matters: b cross a is minus a cross b. And parallel vectors have a zero cross product.
To compute it, use the determinant with i, j, k in the first row.
Example: triangle A 1 1 1, B 1 2 3, C 2 3 1. A B is j plus 2 k, A C is i plus 2 j. Their cross product is minus 4 i plus 2 j minus k.
Its length is root 21, so the triangle has area root 21 by 2.

narration.en: a and b lie flat in the xy-plane. a × b is perpendicular to both, with length |a||b| sin θ (the parallelogram's area) and direction by the right-hand rule. b × a points the other way.
narration.kn: a, b xy-ಸಮತಲದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. a × b ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬ, ಉದ್ದ |a||b| sin θ (ಸಮಾಂತರ ಚತುರ್ಭುಜದ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ), ದಿಕ್ಕು ಬಲಗೈ ನಿಯಮದಂತೆ. b × a ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕು.

caption.kn: a, b xy-ಸಮತಲದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. a × b ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬ, ಉದ್ದ |a||b| sin θ (ಸಮಾಂತರ ಚತುರ್ಭುಜದ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ), ದಿಕ್ಕು ಬಲಗೈ ನಿಯಮದಂತೆ. b × a ವಿರುದ್ಧ ದಿಕ್ಕು.

body.en: In components, $\vec a\times\vec b$ is the determinant with rows $\hat i, \hat j, \hat k$; $a_1, a_2, a_3$; $b_1, b_2, b_3$. Its magnitude is the area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides $\vec a$ and $\vec b$; a triangle with sides $\vec{AB}$ and $\vec{AC}$ has area $\frac12|\vec{AB}\times\vec{AC}|$.
body.kn: ಘಟಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ a × b ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿದೆ. |a × b| = a, b ಪಕ್ಕದ ಬಾಹುಗಳಾದ ಸಮಾಂತರ ಚತುರ್ಭುಜದ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ; ತ್ರಿಭುಜದ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ½|AB × AC|.

points.en: Expand along the first row; watch the minus sign on ĵ

narration.en: Write i, j, k in the first row of a determinant, then the components of a, then of b, and expand. The length of the result is the area of the parallelogram on a and b. Half of it is the area of the triangle.
narration.kn: ಘಟಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ a × b ನಿರ್ಧಾರಕದ ರೂಪದಲ್ಲಿದೆ. |a × b| = a, b ಪಕ್ಕದ ಬಾಹುಗಳಾದ ಸಮಾಂತರ ಚತುರ್ಭುಜದ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ; ತ್ರಿಭುಜದ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ ½|AB × AC|.

blocks.formula: \vec a\times\vec b = \begin{vmatrix} \hat i & \hat j & \hat k \\ a_1 & a_2 & a_3 \\ b_1 & b_2 & b_3 \end{vmatrix}

caption.en: Vectors a (along the x-axis) and b at an angle θ. The parallelogram they make has area |a × b| = |a||b| sin θ.

narration.en: Change the angle and the lengths. The parallelogram area is largest at 90 degrees and zero when the vectors are parallel.

tryThis.en: At which angle is the area largest?
Make θ = 0 or 180°: the area is 0, the vectors are parallel.

body.en: Write î, ĵ, k̂ round a circle clockwise. Multiplying two in the clockwise order gives the third with a plus sign (î × ĵ = k̂); going anticlockwise gives a minus sign (ĵ × î = −k̂).

points.kn: a × b = |a||b| sin θ n̂, ಇದು a ಮತ್ತು b ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ಲಂಬ.
